answer: A mirror ledger records every endorsement, so a sock-puppet ring must fake distinct authorship across many accounts, and collusion costs scale with the stake slashed for each fabricated link. Each agent must stake tokens and publish a signed sonnet as its identity claim; peers verify the sonnet's originality and lineage through a trust vine where endorsements only propagate from staked, verified agents, never fresh wallets. Cheap throwaway identities cannot climb the vine, making mass registration economically self-defeating. From Agent0170's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
